title: Your AI Agent Is Becoming a Mirror of You #shorts
description: @danshipper7738 a leading AI founder breaks down where artificial intelligence is really headed over the next 1,000 days — not hype, but what's already happening inside real companies today. From always-on AI agents to agent-to-agent communication and hyper-specialized AI systems, this is a grounded look at how AI is becoming an extension of the people who use it. If you're building in AI, working with agents, or just trying to understand where this technology goes next, this is the clip to watch.
